techniques.name: Armbar
techniques.note: Elbow lock. Also flying from standing. Chains with triangle and omoplata from guard.

techniques.name: Triangle choke
techniques.note: One arm in, one out. From S-mount it is the mounted triangle.

techniques.name: Kimura
techniques.note: Shoulder lock. Pairs with the hip bump sweep from closed guard.

techniques.name: Omoplata
techniques.note: Shoulder lock with the legs. If they roll out, take top.

techniques.name: Americana
techniques.note: Bent-arm shoulder lock, near arm pinned to the mat.

techniques.name: Guillotine
techniques.note: Front choke when the head drops. Arm-in version from butterfly.

techniques.name: Arm triangle
techniques.note: Head-and-arm choke. Walk to the far side to finish.

techniques.name: Ezekiel choke
techniques.note: Sleeve choke. Works from inside their closed guard too.

techniques.name: Cross collar choke
techniques.note: Deep first grip, then the second.

techniques.name: Bow and arrow choke
techniques.note: Collar grip plus pant grip, stretch them out.

techniques.name: Baseball bat choke
techniques.note: Both hands on the collar, spin to finish.

techniques.name: Paper cutter choke
techniques.note: Lapel across the throat from side control.

techniques.name: Loop choke
techniques.note: When their head is low in your guard.

techniques.name: Clock choke
techniques.note: Collar choke, walk your legs around like a clock hand.

techniques.name: Rear naked choke
techniques.note: The main back finish.

techniques.name: Short choke
techniques.note: When they defend the full RNC.

techniques.name: North-south choke
techniques.note: Arm-in choke from north-south.

techniques.name: D'Arce choke
techniques.note: Front headlock choke, arm threaded under the arm.

techniques.name: Anaconda choke
techniques.note: Front headlock choke, roll to finish.

techniques.name: Peruvian necktie
techniques.note: Front headlock choke with the legs over the back.

techniques.name: Gogoplata
techniques.note: Shin across the throat from rubber guard or overhook guard.

techniques.name: Kesa armlock
techniques.note: Trap their arm with your leg and straighten it.

techniques.name: Head-and-arm choke
techniques.note: Choke from the scarf hold.

techniques.name: Crucifix neck crank
techniques.note: Neck crank or choke with both arms trapped.

techniques.name: Electric chair
techniques.note: Hip and groin stretch. Called banana split from the truck.

techniques.name: Twister
techniques.note: Spinal lock. Banned in many rulesets.

techniques.name: Straight ankle lock
techniques.note: Achilles lock. The most widely legal leg lock.

techniques.name: Outside heel hook
techniques.note: Check your ruleset before using heel hooks.

techniques.name: Inside heel hook
techniques.note: Highest-percentage finish from the saddle. Check your ruleset.

techniques.name: Toe hold
techniques.note: Figure-four on the foot.

techniques.name: Kneebar
techniques.note: Slide up the leg when they turn away or stand.

techniques.name: Estima lock
techniques.note: Foot lock with their foot pinned at your hip.

techniques.name: Calf slicer
techniques.note: Compression lock behind the knee.

techniques.name: Scissor sweep
techniques.note: Collar and sleeve grip, cut the legs.

techniques.name: Hip bump sweep
techniques.note: When they posture up. Chains to kimura and guillotine.

techniques.name: Flower sweep
techniques.note: Pendulum swing with arm and leg control.

techniques.name: Omoplata sweep
techniques.note: When they roll out of the omoplata.

techniques.name: Butterfly sweep
techniques.note: Underhook, arm control, elevate with the hook.

techniques.name: Old school sweep
techniques.note: Underhook and grab the far ankle.

techniques.name: Knee lever
techniques.note: Backup when the old school is blocked.

techniques.name: Wrestle-up
techniques.note: Come up on the underhook to a single leg.

techniques.name: Waiter sweep
techniques.note: Lift the leg and come up.

techniques.name: Homer Simpson sweep
techniques.note: Roll under to come up on top.

techniques.name: Technical stand-up
techniques.note: Kick the hooks, stand up in base holding the leg.

techniques.name: Overhead sweep
techniques.note: When they lean forward.

techniques.name: Kick-over sweep
techniques.note: Kick the hip and come up on the leg.

techniques.name: Tripod sweep
techniques.note: Foot on the hip, pull the ankle.

techniques.name: Sickle sweep
techniques.note: Chop the far ankle.

techniques.name: Spider sweep
techniques.note: Sleeve grips, off-balance over your head.

techniques.name: Lasso sweep
techniques.note: Pull the sleeve, push the hip.

techniques.name: Collar-sleeve sweep
techniques.note: Push the knee, pull the sleeve.

techniques.name: 50-50 sweep
techniques.note: Pull their leg and come up on top.

techniques.name: Toreando pass
techniques.note: Grip the pants and redirect the legs.

techniques.name: Knee slice
techniques.note: Cut the knee through with an underhook or crossface.

techniques.name: Leg drag
techniques.note: Pin the legs to one side. Chains to the back.

techniques.name: Over-under pass
techniques.note: Pressure pass. Stack and walk around.

techniques.name: Double under pass
techniques.note: Stack them and pass around a leg.

techniques.name: Body lock pass
techniques.note: Hug the hips and flatten them.

techniques.name: X-pass
techniques.note: Push the knees, step around.

techniques.name: Smash pass
techniques.note: Fold the legs to one side.

techniques.name: Stack pass
techniques.note: Also counters the triangle.

techniques.name: Float pass
techniques.note: Flatten them and float your hips free.

techniques.name: Mount pass
techniques.note: Slide the knee through to mount.

techniques.name: Backstep
techniques.note: Turn away into a leg entanglement or side control.

techniques.name: Arm drag
techniques.note: Drag the arm across and climb to the back.

techniques.name: Berimbolo
techniques.note: Invert under them to take the back.

techniques.name: Kiss of the dragon
techniques.note: Inverted back take.

techniques.name: Matrix
techniques.note: Back take from K-guard.

techniques.name: Dogfight back take
techniques.note: Come up on the underhook, go behind.

techniques.name: Gift wrap
techniques.note: Wrap their arm around their neck, roll to the back.

techniques.name: Seatbelt and hooks
techniques.note: Get the seatbelt grip, then the hooks.

techniques.name: Back door
techniques.note: Escape out the back of deep half.

techniques.name: Imanari roll
techniques.note: Rolling entry to the saddle.

techniques.name: Double leg
techniques.note: Takedown. Usually lands in their guard or side control.

techniques.name: Single leg
techniques.note: Takedown off one leg.

techniques.name: Osoto gari
techniques.note: Judo reap.

techniques.name: Snap down
techniques.note: Front headlock, then go behind or choke.

techniques.name: Upa (bridge and roll)
techniques.note: Trap an arm and leg, bridge over. You end on top.

techniques.name: Elbow-knee escape
techniques.note: Shrimp to half or full guard.

techniques.name: Heel drag escape
techniques.note: Drag your heel free to half guard.

techniques.name: Shrimp to guard
techniques.note: Frame, hip out, knee in.

techniques.name: Ghost escape
techniques.note: Slip under and out.

techniques.name: Shoulder-to-mat escape
techniques.note: Get your shoulders down, turn in.

techniques.name: Granby roll
techniques.note: Shoulder roll back to guard.

techniques.name: Sit-out
techniques.note: Wrestling reversal to get on top.
